settings.heading: The screen is one step.
settings.desc: An at-home drug screen provides an initial result, not a clinical diagnosis. A breathalyser reading also cannot guarantee that you are safe or legally permitted to drive.
settings.substances_note: Use the control indicator, result window and interpretation guide supplied with the exact product. Different products use different layouts and thresholds.
settings.screen_desc: If the control indicator is absent or the result is otherwise invalid, do not interpret it—repeat the test with a new device. For a non-negative drug screen, review the instructions and seek professional confirmation where the outcome matters.
settings.confirm_desc: Do not drive, operate machinery or take another safety-sensitive action if you may be impaired. If someone is unresponsive, having trouble breathing or may have overdosed, call triple zero (000) immediately.

settings.heading: Which home drug test should I choose?
settings.text: Start with the sample type you can collect correctly and the substances you need the product to screen for. Check the panel, instructions, expiry date and intended use on the product page before purchasing. If you are unsure, contact Andatech for product-selection help.

settings.heading: What is the difference between saliva and urine drug tests?
settings.text: They use different sample types and can suit different screening needs. Detection depends on the substance, product, timing and individual factors, so use the information supplied with the exact test rather than a general estimate.

settings.heading: Does a non-negative home drug test confirm drug use?
settings.text: No. An at-home screen provides an initial result and is not a clinical diagnosis. Check the product instructions and seek professional confirmation where the outcome will affect medical, legal, employment or other important decisions.

settings.heading: What should I do if the test is invalid?
settings.text: Do not interpret an invalid test. Review the instructions, check the expiry and storage conditions, then repeat the process with a new test. Contact Andatech if the issue continues.

settings.heading: Can medication affect a drug screen?
settings.text: Some medicines or substances may be relevant to an unexpected screening result. Do not stop prescribed medication without medical advice. Review the product information and speak with a pharmacist, doctor or other qualified professional if you are concerned.

settings.heading: Does a low breathalyser reading mean I am safe to drive?
settings.text: No device reading is permission to drive. Alcohol affects people differently, readings can change over time, and licence conditions and local laws apply. If there is any doubt, do not drive and use another way home.

settings.heading: How often does a personal breathalyser need calibration?
settings.text: The schedule depends on the model, time since service and number of tests performed. Follow the calibration interval in your product instructions and service reminders.

settings.heading: When should I seek urgent help?
settings.text: If someone is unresponsive, having trouble breathing, experiencing severe symptoms or may have overdosed, call triple zero (000) immediately and ask for an ambulance. Do not wait for a home test result.
